values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again.

values.note: ReserveAmerica sells 28 campsites (the park says thirty) plus a tent shelter. The only sites with a listed length are 001-009 and 011, all 15 ft (sites 001, 002 and 009 pull-through); site 001's details read 'Max Vehicle Length: 15'. Sites 12-14 are hike-in (about 100 yards uphill); the rest of loop 011-030 are tent sites with no length.

summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 761): reservable, no electric, phone 518-733-5400. Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, 28 campsites, max 15 ft (3 pull-through), showers, opening after 'Closed through Fri May 21 2027'. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of field facts and the 'late June' opening the status line contradicts. Not stated: closing date, dump, water/sewer.
flags: Criteria: no site takes a 23-ft rig. Every campsite with a listed length is 15 ft (sites 001-009 and 011; site 001's details: 'Driveway Length: 15', 'Max Vehicle Length: 15'), and the rest are tent or hike-in sites with no length (ReserveAmerica site list, parkId 761, read 2026-10-21). The inclusion_evidence ('10 drive-in trailer sites confirmed') rests on the trailer-site count, not on a length. Suggest drop under the ~23-ft minimum.
